packages.name: Kochi – Munnar – Thekkady – Alleppey Classic Tour
packages.destinations: Kochi (1N) – Munnar (2N) – Thekkady (1N) – Alleppey Houseboat (1N) – Marari/Kochi (1N)
packages.shortDescription: The quintessential Kerala holiday covering mist-clad tea gardens, aromatic spice plantations, Periyar wildlife reserve, and an unforgettable backwater houseboat cruise.
packages.basicItinerary: Day 1: Kochi arrival & Fort Kochi | Day 2-3: Munnar Tea Gardens & Eravikulam | Day 4: Thekkady Wildlife Sanctuary & Spice Plantation | Day 5: Alleppey Deluxe Houseboat Backwater Cruise | Day 6: Marari Beach relaxation | Day 7: Kochi departure

completeItinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi & Heritage Sightseeing
completeItinerary.desc: Meet our friendly chauffeur at Cochin International Airport / Ernakulam Railway Station. Transfer to your handpicked hotel. In the afternoon, visit iconic Chinese Fishing Nets, St. Francis Church, Mattancherry Dutch Palace, and the vibrant Jewish Synagogue.
completeItinerary.stay: Premium Hotel in Fort Kochi / Ernakulam

completeItinerary.title: Scenic Drive to Munnar via Cheeyappara Waterfalls
completeItinerary.desc: Enjoy breakfast and embark on a picturesque 4-hour drive up into the Western Ghats. Stop en route at Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls. Check-in to your resort surrounded by lush mist-wrapped cardamom hills. Evening free for local town visit.

completeItinerary.title: Munnar Tea Estates, Eravikulam & Mattupetty Dam
completeItinerary.desc: Full day excursion in Munnar. Visit Eravikulam National Park (home to the endangered Nilgiri Tahr), Tata Tea Museum, Mattupetty Lake & Dam, Echo Point, and Kundala Dam. Experience boating surrounded by rolling tea gardens.

completeItinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady (Periyar Tiger Reserve)
completeItinerary.desc: Drive to Thekkady (Periyar). Check in to your forest-edge resort. In the afternoon, visit an organic spice plantation with a guided herbal tour. Optional evening Periyar lake boating or traditional Kathakali & Kalaripayattu martial arts show.

completeItinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey – Private Traditional Houseboat
completeItinerary.desc: Board your private handcrafted Kerala houseboat (Kettuvallam) at 12:00 PM. Glide through tranquil palm-fringed backwaters, paddy fields, and lagoons. Relish authentic freshly prepared Kerala cuisine on board with personal chef and crew.
completeItinerary.meals: Welcome Drink, Lunch, High Tea & Dinner

completeItinerary.title: Alleppey to Marari Beach & Backwater Serenity
completeItinerary.desc: Awake to a peaceful sunrise over the backwaters. After a traditional breakfast, disembark at 9:00 AM and drive to nearby pristine Marari Beach. Relax under swaying coconut groves, witness fishing catamarans, and unwind.

completeItinerary.title: Souvenir Shopping & Departure from Kochi
completeItinerary.desc: Savor a leisurely breakfast. Explore Lulu Mall or local spice bazaars for organic black pepper, cardamom, banana chips, and handwoven textiles. Your private chauffeur drops you at Kochi Airport/Station with beautiful Kerala memories.

highlights: Private AC vehicle for all 7 days with knowledgeable English/Hindi speaking driver
Exclusive private Alleppey Houseboat stay with all traditional Kerala meals included
2 Nights in scenic Munnar hills with tea garden views
Periyar Spice Plantation guided walking tour
Flexible customizable schedule tailored to your pace
inclusions: Accommodation for 6 Nights in handpicked 3-Star/4-Star boutique hotels & resorts

Daily delicious buffet breakfast at all hotels

Fuel charges, toll gate fees, parking charges, and driver allowances
24/7 dedicated Kerala local travel expert assistance on call

packages.name: Munnar & Alleppey Honeymoon Romance Special
packages.destinations: Kochi Arrival – Munnar (3N) – Alleppey Houseboat (1N) – Kochi Departure
packages.shortDescription: Specially crafted for newlyweds. Misty mountain cuddles, private candlelit dinner, flower bed decoration in a tranquil Alleppey houseboat.
packages.basicItinerary: Day 1: Kochi to Munnar scenic drive | Day 2: Munnar Tea Gardens & Echo Point | Day 3: Top Station & Candlelight Dinner | Day 4: Private Alleppey Houseboat Cruise | Day 5: Kochi departure

completeItinerary.title: Kochi Arrival & Journey to Romantic Munnar
completeItinerary.desc: Warm welcome by your private chauffeur. Ascend the misty Ghats, pausing at scenic viewpoints for memorable couple photos. Check in to your honeymoon room with mountain valley panorama.

completeItinerary.title: Munnar Tea Valley, Mattupetty & Echo Point
completeItinerary.desc: Explore the verdant tea slopes hand-in-hand. Whisper your love at Echo Point, enjoy a romantic shikara boat ride on Kundala Lake, and visit the Rose Gardens.

completeItinerary.title: Eravikulam Tahr Spotting & Leisure Day
completeItinerary.desc: Morning visit to Rajamalai peak in Eravikulam National Park. Afternoon at your resort for private spa relaxation, warm tea, and quiet romantic moments amidst misty breezes.

completeItinerary.title: Munnar to Alleppey – Romantic Houseboat Overnight
completeItinerary.desc: Board your private honeymoon houseboat. Enjoy welcome coconut water, freshly caught Karimeen fish fry lunch, sunset backwater cruising, special honeymoon cake, and flower bed decor.
completeItinerary.meals: All meals + Honeymoon Cake & Flower Decor

completeItinerary.title: Morning Cruise & Transfer to Kochi
completeItinerary.desc: Wake up to the soft lap of water and birdsong. After breakfast, transfer back to Kochi for departure flight/train with a heart full of memories.

packages.name: Complete Kerala Family Vacation (Hills, Wildlife & Beaches)
packages.shortDescription: The ultimate family package crafted for all ages. Kids love the elephant sanctuaries and beaches, while parents relax in the misty hills and tranquil backwaters.
packages.basicItinerary: Day 1: Kochi arrival | Day 2-3: Munnar hills & tea gardens | Day 4: Thekkady wildlife & spice plantation | Day 5: Alleppey backwaters | Day 6-7: Kovalam beach & Trivandrum temple | Day 8: Trivandrum departure

completeItinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi & Kochi Sights
completeItinerary.desc: Warm welcome at Kochi airport/railway station. Transfer to family-friendly hotel. Visit Marine Drive and Jewish Town.

completeItinerary.title: Kochi to Munnar via Waterfalls
completeItinerary.desc: Enjoy a scenic drive through hills, stopping at Cheeyappara waterfalls. Check in to Munnar family resort.

completeItinerary.title: Munnar Family Sightseeing
completeItinerary.desc: Visit Eravikulam National Park to spot mountain goats. Enjoy speed boating at Mattupetty Dam and Echo Point shouts.

completeItinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady Elephant & Spice Tour
completeItinerary.desc: Scenic drive to Periyar. Guided family walk through spice farm. Optional elephant interaction and evening cultural martial arts show.

completeItinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey Houseboat Cruise
completeItinerary.desc: Board your private family houseboat in Alleppey. Cruise picturesque canals with delicious traditional Kerala lunch and dinner.

completeItinerary.title: Alleppey to Kovalam Golden Beaches
completeItinerary.desc: Disembark and drive south along the Arabian coastline to famous Kovalam beach. Check in to beachside resort. Sunset at Lighthouse Beach.

completeItinerary.title: Kovalam Beach & Trivandrum Heritage
completeItinerary.desc: Visit Padmanabhaswamy Temple (architectural marvel), Napier Museum, and enjoy swimming and beach sports at Samudra Beach.

completeItinerary.title: Departure from Trivandrum (TRV)
completeItinerary.desc: After breakfast, checkout and transfer to Trivandrum Airport / Railway Station for journey home with fond family memories.

highlights: Comprehensive itinerary covering hills, forests, backwaters, and golden beaches
Kid-friendly sightseeing with boat rides, elephant centers, and interactive spice gardens
Spacious AC Innova Crysta for comfortable family road trips
Private Alleppey Houseboat experience with dedicated family crew

packages.name: Wayanad Nature, Caves & Rainforest Escape
packages.shortDescription: Discover the mystical rainforests of North Kerala. Edakkal prehistoric caves, Banasura Sagar earthen dam, and Chembra peak vistas.
packages.basicItinerary: Day 1: Calicut to Wayanad ascent | Day 2: Edakkal Caves & Soochipara Falls | Day 3: Banasura Sagar Dam & Kuruva Island | Day 4: Calicut departure

completeItinerary.title: Calicut to Wayanad Ghats
completeItinerary.desc: Meet at Calicut Airport/Station and drive through the dramatic Thamarassery Churam 9 hairpin curves into the cool Wayanad plateau. Visit Pookode Lake and Lakkidi Viewpoint.

completeItinerary.title: Prehistoric Edakkal Caves & Soochipara Falls
completeItinerary.desc: Trek up to Edakkal Caves with Neolithic stone carvings dating back thousands of years. In the afternoon, explore the thundering Soochipara Waterfalls nestled inside dense jungle.

completeItinerary.title: Banasura Sagar Dam & Kuruva Island
completeItinerary.desc: Visit Banasura Sagar, India’s largest earthen dam. Enjoy speedboat rides over misty reservoirs. Afternoon walk in the riverine bamboo forests of Kuruva Dweep.

completeItinerary.title: Calicut Beach & Departure
completeItinerary.desc: Drive back down to Calicut. Savor authentic Malabar Biryani and Kozhikodan Halwa. Transfer to Calicut Airport/Railway station.

highlights: Stay in eco-resorts amidst coffee & cardamom estates
Exploration of the ancient Edakkal Neolithic cave engravings
Speed boating at Banasura Sagar Dam with mountain backdrops
Ideal for nature lovers, photographers, and young weekend travelers
inclusions: 3 Nights accommodation in premium Wayanad nature resort
Daily breakfast and dinner
Dedicated AC vehicle for all transfers and sightseeing
Driver allowances, parking, and toll fees
packages.hotelInformation: Eco-resorts nestled among tea and coffee estates with jungle walking trails.

packages.name: Athirappilly Niagara & Alleppey Backwaters Short Break
packages.destinations: Kochi Arrival – Athirappilly Waterfalls (1N) – Alleppey Houseboat (1N) – Marari/Kochi (1N)
packages.shortDescription: Witness India’s majestic Niagara at Athirappilly and sail through the serene Alleppey backwaters on a quick rejuvenating 4-day escape.
packages.basicItinerary: Day 1: Kochi to Athirappilly Waterfalls | Day 2: Athirappilly to Alleppey Houseboat cruise | Day 3: Alleppey to Marari beach & Fort Kochi | Day 4: Kochi departure

completeItinerary.title: Kochi to Athirappilly Waterfalls
completeItinerary.desc: Pick up from Kochi. Scenic drive to Athirappilly, where Bahubali was filmed. Trek down to the base of the thundering 80-foot falls. Check into forest resort.

completeItinerary.title: Athirappilly to Alleppey Houseboat Check-in
completeItinerary.desc: Drive to Alleppey. Board your luxury private houseboat at noon. Relax as the vessel sails through backwater channels and lagoons.

completeItinerary.title: Alleppey to Marari Beach & Kochi Heritage
completeItinerary.desc: After morning breakfast on board, head to Marari Beach and Fort Kochi. Stroll through art cafes and see Chinese fishing nets at sunset.

completeItinerary.title: Departure from Kochi
completeItinerary.desc: Enjoy morning breakfast and souvenir shopping before drop-off at Cochin Airport or Ernakulam Railway Station.

highlights: Stand before the mighty 80-foot Athirappilly waterfalls
Overnight cruise in a private Alleppey houseboat
Perfect short getaway for working professionals and couples
inclusions: 3 Nights premium accommodation
All meals on Alleppey Houseboat
Daily breakfast at hotels
Private AC Sedan with courteous chauffeur

packages.name: Luxury Ayurvedic Wellness & Kumarakom Backwaters
packages.destinations: Kochi (1N) – Kumarakom (2N) – Marari Luxury Beach Resort (2N)
packages.shortDescription: Ultimate luxury and rejuvenation. Experience 5-star lakeside resorts in Kumarakom, authentic Kerala Ayurvedic Abhyanga massages, and serene private beach villas in Marari.
packages.basicItinerary: Day 1: Kochi luxury check-in | Day 2-3: Kumarakom luxury lake resort & bird sanctuary | Day 4-5: Marari private beach villa & Ayurvedic wellness | Day 6: Kochi departure

completeItinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi & Heritage Luxury
completeItinerary.desc: VIP pick-up in premium SUV. Check in to a 5-star heritage property. Evening sunset yacht cruise on Cochin harbour.

completeItinerary.title: Kochi to Kumarakom Lake Resort
completeItinerary.desc: Scenic drive to Kumarakom on the banks of Vembanad Lake. Check in to a luxury lake-view villa with traditional Kerala architecture and private plunge pool.

completeItinerary.title: Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary & Sunset Cruise
completeItinerary.desc: Early morning bird sanctuary boat ride. Afternoon complimentary traditional Ayurvedic full-body herbal oil massage. Evening private sunset cruise.

completeItinerary.title: Kumarakom to Marari Private Beach Villa
completeItinerary.desc: Transfer to Marari. Check in to private thatched roof cottage facing the ocean. Unwind with yoga by the beach and fresh organic farm cuisine.

completeItinerary.title: Marari Beach Relaxation & Wellness
completeItinerary.desc: Full day of blissful relaxation. Ayurvedic rejuvenation therapy, beach strolls, organic culinary class, and private candlelight dinner on the sand.

completeItinerary.title: Kochi Departure
completeItinerary.desc: Farewell breakfast overlooking the Arabian Sea. Private transfer to Kochi airport with personalized souvenir gift box.

branding.footerDescription: Kerala's premier experiential travel company. We curate handcrafted holidays featuring misty hills, tranquil backwaters, authentic houseboats, and serene beaches.

testimonials.review: Our Kerala honeymoon with TravStories was simply magical! The private houseboat in Alleppey with candlelit dinner and cake was breathtaking. Our driver Manoj was so polite, punctual, and knew all the scenic spots in Munnar. Highly recommended!

Planning a 7-day trip with two energetic kids could have been stressful, but TravStories took care of everything. Handpicked family resorts with clean pools, spacious Innova, and excellent hotel choices. The kids loved the elephant center and backwater boats!

Best road trip experience! The waterfalls at Athirappilly and Edakkal cave trek in Wayanad were thrilling. Transparent pricing, no hidden costs, and our travel coordinator was available 24/7 on WhatsApp. Will book Kashmir next with them!
